name: Lanebound generic telegraphs
note: Same key shape as the champion atlas: sprites[name] = {rect, anchor}; animations[name][variant] = {n, ms, fps, loop, frames[{i, rect, anchor, hit}]} (variant = blue | red). Per-champion VFX in {slug}/vfx/ win when present (spec 5.4). The sprites are REFERENCE renders of a pure pixel rule; the renderer should evaluate the rule (gen/telegraph.py) so any radius / width / length / angle works. Hit math never reads these.

recipe.world: tile = 44x32 px at 2x; shapes are defined in world tiles then mapped through that anisotropic tile, so a circle of radius r is an ellipse r*44 by r*32 px
recipe.line: 0 <= t <= L and |s| <= w/2 (t along aim, s across, world units)
recipe.fill: 50% checker on 2x2 px cells ((px//2 + py//2) even), caster team colour, alpha 80
recipe.rim: inside px within 2 px of the edge, kept where (px//4 + py//4) even, team colour +30% lightness, alpha 230
recipe.dash: 2-3 chevrons along the move at d_k = 0.6 + (L-0.6)*0.85*k/(n-1) tiles, 3 px thick, arms ~13 px, alpha 255/190/110, team tint or ivory (no gold), fade out over 200 ms
recipe.impact: cream star #FFF0C8 + white core, 4 frames @60 ms, then the 4x6 (1x) team pin
recipe.sanctuary: clip every telegraph to the board minus the ENEMY sanctuary columns (blue casts clip at x >= 22*44, red casts at x < 2*44); no fill, no rim, no damage inside (build spec 5.1)
recipe.viewer_only: telegraphs are drawn from the cast's land position; they never change sim state
